records.name: Help for Texans (local housing help finder)
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: A free online search tool. You pick the kind of help you need, type your city or county, and it shows local groups that help with rent, utility bills, home repair, buying a home, and avoiding foreclosure.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Any Texas resident can use the search. Each local program has its own rules.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the Help for Texans page, choose the type of help, and enter your city or county. Then contact the local group it lists.
records.notes: TDHCA does not give money directly to people; it funds local provider organizations. Apply through the local group the tool lists.
records.description_es: Una herramienta gratis en internet. Usted escoge el tipo de ayuda que necesita, escribe su ciudad o condado, y le muestra grupos locales que ayudan con la renta, los recibos de luz y gas, arreglos de la casa, comprar casa y evitar perder su casa por falta de pago (ejecución hipotecaria).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que vive en Texas puede usar la búsqueda. Cada programa local tiene sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Entre a la página Help for Texans, escoja el tipo de ayuda y escriba su ciudad o condado. Luego llame o comuníquese con el grupo local que aparece.

records.name: TDHCA Vacancy Clearinghouse (reduced-rent apartment search)
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: An online list of apartments that got state help and may have lower rent. You can search for open units near you.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For renters looking for affordable apartments. Each property sets its own income limits.
records.how_to_apply: Search the Vacancy Clearinghouse online, then call or visit the apartment property to apply.
records.notes: Linked from TDHCA's Help for Texans page under reduced-rent apartment search.
records.description_es: Una lista en internet de apartamentos que recibieron ayuda del estado y que pueden tener renta más baja. Puede buscar apartamentos disponibles cerca de usted.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan un apartamento a buen precio. Cada edificio pone sus propios límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque en el Vacancy Clearinghouse por internet y luego llame o visite el edificio de apartamentos para pedir una solicitud.

records.name: Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program (TDHCA)
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: Section 8 vouchers help low-income families pay rent to private landlords. TDHCA runs vouchers in some counties where there is no other local housing authority.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households living in TDHCA's voucher service area. Waitlists often apply.
records.how_to_apply: Current applicants and voucher holders can check waitlist status on the TDHCA PHA Portal. People outside TDHCA's area should contact their local public housing authority.
records.notes: TDHCA's Section 8 program covers a 34-county service area (counties not listed on the page). TDHCA's page lists no Section 8 phone number. For questions about other housing authorities, the page lists HUD's PIH Resource Center at (800) 955-2232. Most Texans get vouchers from their city or county housing authority instead.
records.description_es: Los vales de la Sección 8 ayudan a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar la renta a dueños privados. TDHCA maneja vales en algunos condados donde no hay otra oficina local de vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos que viven en el área de servicio de TDHCA. Muchas veces hay lista de espera.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si ya aplicó o ya tiene un vale, puede ver su lugar en la lista de espera en el portal PHA de TDHCA. Si vive fuera del área de TDHCA, comuníquese con la oficina de vivienda pública de su ciudad o condado.

records.name: Find Your Local Public Housing Agency (Section 8 and Public Housing)
records.organization: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)
records.description_en: HUD keeps a list of local public housing agencies. These agencies run public housing and Section 8 vouchers in your city or county.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income renters who want public housing or a Section 8 voucher. Each local agency sets its own waitlist and rules.
records.how_to_apply: Open HUD's PHA contact page, pick Texas, and find the agency for your city or county. Contact that agency to apply or join its waitlist.
records.notes: Phone is HUD's Public and Indian Housing (PIH) Customer Service Center, which answers questions about public housing and voucher programs. The PHA contact list is updated weekly.
records.description_es: HUD tiene una lista de las oficinas locales de vivienda pública. Estas oficinas manejan la vivienda pública y los vales de la Sección 8 en su ciudad o condado.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que rentan y quieren vivienda pública o un vale de la Sección 8. Cada oficina local tiene su propia lista de espera y sus reglas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Abra la página de contactos de HUD, escoja Texas y busque la oficina de su ciudad o condado. Comuníquese con esa oficina para aplicar o entrar a la lista de espera.

records.name: HUD-Approved Housing Counselor Finder
records.organization: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (using HUD's counselor list)
records.description_en: Search by ZIP code to find a HUD-approved housing counselor near you. Counselors help with renting, buying a home, credit, and avoiding foreclosure.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to anyone. Counseling is often free or low cost.
records.how_to_apply: Enter your ZIP code on the finder page and call a listed agency to set up counseling.
records.notes: Phone is the CFPB line. Use to find HUD-approved housing counseling agencies in any Texas ZIP code.
records.description_es: Busque por código postal para encontrar un consejero de vivienda aprobado por HUD cerca de usted. Los consejeros ayudan con rentar, comprar casa, el crédito y evitar perder su casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos. Muchas veces la consejería es gratis o cuesta poco.
records.how_to_apply_es: Escriba su código postal en la página de búsqueda y llame a una de las agencias para hacer una cita.

records.name: Homeowner's HOPE Hotline (foreclosure prevention)
records.organization: Homeowner's HOPE Hotline
records.description_en: A phone line for homeowners who are behind on their mortgage or afraid of losing their home. It connects you with foreclosure help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homeowners having trouble paying their mortgage.
records.how_to_apply: Call the hotline.
records.notes: Listed on TDHCA's Help for Texans page under foreclosure mitigation resources.
records.description_es: Una línea de teléfono para dueños de casa que están atrasados en su hipoteca o tienen miedo de perder su casa. Le conecta con ayuda para evitar el embargo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para dueños de casa que tienen problemas para pagar su hipoteca.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda.

records.name: VA Housing Assistance for Veterans (mortgage and foreclosure help)
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
records.description_en: Helps veterans who are having trouble paying their VA home loan or who face foreclosure.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans and service members with home loan problems.
records.how_to_apply: Call the VA housing assistance line or visit the VA housing assistance website.
records.notes: Phone and link listed on TDHCA's Help for Texans page for veterans housing assistance; TDHCA's HAF page also refers veteran homeowners to va.gov/housing-assistance.
records.description_es: Ayuda a veteranos que tienen problemas para pagar su préstamo de casa del VA o que corren el riesgo de perder su casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos y miembros de las fuerzas armadas con problemas en su préstamo de casa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de vivienda del VA o visite la página de ayuda de vivienda del VA.

records.name: Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF) / National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
records.description_en: SSVF helps veteran families who are homeless or about to lose housing find and keep a home. The national call center connects veterans to local VA and SSVF help, 24 hours a day.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income veterans and their families who are homeless or at risk of becoming homeless.
records.how_to_apply: Call the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans to be connected to the nearest VA or SSVF provider.
records.notes: Free and confidential. Veterans in crisis can call 988 and press 1.
records.description_es: SSVF ayuda a familias de veteranos que no tienen casa o que están a punto de perderla a encontrar y mantener un hogar. El centro nacional de llamadas conecta a los veteranos con ayuda local del VA y de SSVF, las 24 horas del día.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos de bajos ingresos y sus familias que no tienen casa o que corren el riesgo de quedarse sin casa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Centro Nacional de Llamadas para Veteranos sin Hogar y le conectarán con la oficina del VA o de SSVF más cercana.

records.name: Texas Balance of State Coordinated Entry (homeless services)
records.organization: Texas Homeless Network
records.description_en: Texas Homeless Network runs the system that connects people who are homeless to shelter and housing in most Texas areas outside the big cities. Local 'entry points' do the intake.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who are homeless or at risk of homelessness in the Texas Balance of State area.
records.how_to_apply: Use THN's coordinated entry map to find the entry point for your area, or use THN's Find Help page. If you cannot use the map, email CE@thn.org.
records.notes: THN is the Texas Balance of State Continuum of Care (communities outside major metros like Houston, Dallas, Austin, San Antonio, Fort Worth, El Paso which have their own CoCs). CE regions include Abilene, Beaumont & Orange, Brazoria, Cameron, Colorado Valley, Comal, Corpus Christi, Denton, Galveston, Hays, Concho Valley, Hidalgo, Killeen, Laredo, Longview, Lubbock, Odessa, Panhandle, Texarkana, Victoria, plus a region for other counties. The phone is THN's office, not a crisis line.
records.description_es: Texas Homeless Network maneja el sistema que conecta a personas sin hogar con refugio y vivienda en la mayoría de las áreas de Texas fuera de las ciudades grandes. Unos lugares locales llamados puntos de entrada hacen la entrevista.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que no tienen hogar o que corren el riesgo de quedarse sin hogar en el área del Balance of State de Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el mapa de entrada coordinada de THN para encontrar el punto de entrada de su área, o use la página Find Help de THN. Si no puede usar el mapa, mande un correo a CE@thn.org.

records.name: 2-1-1 Texas (housing and shelter referrals)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Call 2-1-1 to find local help with rent, shelter, foreclosure prevention, and more. You can also search online or chat.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Free for anyone in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Dial 2-1-1 (or the toll-free alternate number) or search the 2-1-1 Texas website.
records.notes: Alternate number: (877) 541-7905. Online chat available in English and Spanish.
records.description_es: Llame al 2-1-1 para encontrar ayuda local con la renta, refugio, cómo evitar perder su casa y más. También puede buscar en internet o chatear.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Gratis para cualquier persona en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Marque 2-1-1 (o el número gratis alterno) o busque en la página de 2-1-1 Texas.

records.name: Texas Homebuyer Program (My First Texas Home / My Choice Texas Home)
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: Low-interest home loans and down payment help for people buying a home in Texas. Also offers homebuyer education and a mortgage tax credit.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texans buying a home who meet income and loan limits. Check eligibility online.
records.how_to_apply: Take the online eligibility quick check, connect with an approved loan officer, and complete a homebuyer education course.
records.cost: Loan program (not free money); down payment assistance available
records.notes: Email: txhomebuyer@tdhca.texas.gov. Includes the Texas Mortgage Credit Certificate Program and the Texas Statewide Homebuyer Education Program.
records.description_es: Préstamos para casa con interés bajo y ayuda para el pago inicial para personas que compran casa en Texas. También ofrece clases para compradores de casa y un crédito de impuestos por la hipoteca.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Texas que compran casa y cumplen con los límites de ingresos y del préstamo. Revise si califica en internet.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la revisión rápida en internet, comuníquese con un agente de préstamos aprobado y tome un curso para compradores de casa.

records.name: TSAHC Homebuyer Programs (Homes for Texas Heroes, Home Sweet Texas)
records.organization: Texas State Affordable Housing Corporation (TSAHC)
records.description_en: Fixed-rate home loans, down payment help, and mortgage tax credits for Texans buying a home. Also offers homebuyer education.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texans buying a home who meet program income rules. Take the online quiz to check.
records.how_to_apply: Take the qualification quiz on the TSAHC website, then work with a participating lender.
records.cost: Loan program; down payment assistance available
records.notes: Homebuyer toll-free line shown. General toll free: (888) 638-3555; main line (512) 477-3555. Homes for Texas Heroes is for teachers, police officers, firefighters, EMS workers, corrections officers, veterans, and active military. Home Sweet Texas is for low- and moderate-income households. Programs require a 620 credit score.
records.description_es: Préstamos para casa con tasa fija, ayuda para el pago inicial y créditos de impuestos por la hipoteca para personas que compran casa en Texas. También ofrece clases para compradores de casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Texas que compran casa y cumplen con las reglas de ingresos del programa. Conteste las preguntas en internet para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Conteste las preguntas para calificar en la página de TSAHC y luego trabaje con un prestamista participante.

records.name: Texas Bootstrap Loan Program (self-help housing)
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: A 0% interest loan of up to $45,000 to build or fix your own home. You must do at least 65% of the building work yourself.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households earning no more than 80% of the area median family income. Not available in all parts of Texas.
records.how_to_apply: On the Help for Texans page, choose 'Help Me Buy a Home' and enter your city or county to find a local Bootstrap provider.
records.notes: Email: Bootstrap@tdhca.texas.gov. Income limit is 80% AMFI (area median), not a % of FPL.
records.description_es: Un préstamo sin interés (0%) de hasta $45,000 para construir o arreglar su propia casa. Usted tiene que hacer por lo menos el 65% del trabajo de construcción.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias que ganan no más del 80% del ingreso medio de su área. No está disponible en todas partes de Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: En la página Help for Texans, escoja 'Help Me Buy a Home' y escriba su ciudad o condado para encontrar un proveedor local de Bootstrap.

records.name: Section 811 Project Rental Assistance
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: Rent help in certain apartments for adults with disabilities who are leaving institutions, have serious mental illness, or are aging out of foster care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Extremely low-income adults age 18 to 61 with a disability who get services through a participating HHSC agency. You must be referred.
records.how_to_apply: Ask your service provider or coordinator to refer you through a Qualified Referral Agent. Direct applications are not accepted.
records.notes: Only in these metro areas: Austin-Round Rock, Brownsville-Harlingen, Corpus Christi, Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington, El Paso, Houston-The Woodlands-Sugar Land, McAllen-Edinburg-Mission, San Antonio-New Braunfels. Must be under 62 at admission.
records.description_es: Ayuda con la renta en ciertos apartamentos para adultos con discapacidad que salen de una institución, que tienen una enfermedad mental grave o que salen del sistema de cuidado temporal (foster care).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 18 a 61 años con ingresos muy bajos y con una discapacidad, que reciben servicios de una agencia participante de HHSC. Alguien tiene que referirle.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pida a su proveedor de servicios o coordinador que le refiera por medio de un Agente de Referencia Calificado. No se aceptan solicitudes directas.

records.name: TDHCA Manufactured Housing Division
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: The state office for manufactured (mobile) homes. It keeps ownership records and takes consumer complaints about sellers, installers, and builders.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texans who own or are buying a manufactured home.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Manufactured Housing Division.
records.notes: Toll-free number listed on TDHCA's Help for Texans page.
records.description_es: La oficina del estado para casas prefabricadas (casas móviles). Guarda los registros de dueños y recibe quejas sobre vendedores, instaladores y fabricantes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Texas que tienen o están comprando una casa prefabricada.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la División de Casas Prefabricadas.

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program (WAP)
records.organization: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
records.description_en: Free home repairs that save energy, like insulation, caulking, weather-stripping, and fixing or replacing heating and cooling systems. A local agency does the work.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. In 2026 the income limit is up to 200% of the federal poverty level for DOE-funded weatherization (150% for LIHEAP-funded weatherization).
records.how_to_apply: Contact the weatherization agency that serves your county (see the county list or Help for Texans).
records.notes: 2026 Program Year guidelines (effective Jan 26, 2026): DOE-WAP 200% FPIG; LIHEAP-WAP 150% FPIG; CEAP 150% FPIG. Source: https://www.tdhca.texas.gov/community-affairs-income-guidelines. Local agencies may have waitlists.
records.description_es: Arreglos gratis en la casa para ahorrar energía, como aislamiento, sellar grietas, tiras contra el aire y arreglar o cambiar el aire acondicionado y la calefacción. Una agencia local hace el trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos. En 2026 el límite es hasta el 200% del nivel federal de pobreza para el programa pagado por DOE (150% para el programa pagado por LIHEAP).
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con la agencia de weatherization de su condado (vea la lista de condados o Help for Texans).

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program - Alamo Area Council of Governments
records.organization: Alamo Area Council of Governments
records.description_en: Free energy-saving home repairs such as insulation, weather-stripping, and heating and cooling system repair or replacement for low-income households in this agency's counties.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households in the counties listed. In 2026 the income limit is up to 200% of the federal poverty level for DOE-funded weatherization (150% for LIHEAP-funded).
records.how_to_apply: Call the agency to ask for a weatherization application.
records.notes: From TDHCA's Subrecipient Contact List (dated 7/21/2023), which is the list linked on TDHCA's WAP page in 2026. Call to confirm the agency still serves your county and to ask about waitlists.
records.description_es: Arreglos gratis en la casa para ahorrar energía, como aislamiento, tiras contra el aire y arreglar o cambiar el aire acondicionado y la calefacción, para familias de bajos ingresos en los condados que atiende esta agencia.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos en los condados de la lista. En 2026 el límite es hasta el 200% del nivel federal de pobreza para el programa pagado por DOE (150% para el pagado por LIHEAP).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la agencia y pida una solicitud de weatherization.

records.how_to_apply: Call the clinics.
records.notes: Listed on TexasLawHelp.org's eviction page for Harris County. The college's own website could not be opened to double-check details; call first.
records.description_es: Clínicas de una escuela de leyes que dan ayuda legal gratis, incluso a inquilinos que enfrentan un desalojo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el condado de Harris que cumplen con las reglas de la clínica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a las clínicas.

records.name: Disability Rights Texas
records.organization: Disability Rights Texas
records.description_en: Free legal advocacy for Texans with disabilities facing discrimination, including housing discrimination and accessibility problems.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texans with disabilities who have a disability-related legal problem. They do not provide emergency eviction help.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online anytime at intake.drtx.org or call the intake line during intake hours.
records.hours: Intake: Monday-Thursday, 10 a.m.-noon and 1 p.m.-3 p.m. Central
records.notes: Video phone for Deaf callers: (866) 362-2851 or (512) 271-9391. Decisions take at least 10 business days. Not for Social Security applications/appeals or emergency evictions; for emergency evictions they refer people to local legal aid or 1-800-252-9690.
records.description_es: Defensa legal gratis para personas en Texas con discapacidad que sufren discriminación, incluso discriminación en la vivienda y problemas de acceso.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Texas con una discapacidad que tienen un problema legal relacionado con su discapacidad. No dan ayuda de emergencia con desalojos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en internet a cualquier hora en intake.drtx.org o llame a la línea de admisión en el horario de atención.

records.name: Housing Discrimination Complaints (Fair Housing)
records.organization: Texas Workforce Commission - Civil Rights Division
records.description_en: File a complaint if you were treated unfairly when renting or buying a home in Texas because of things like race, religion, disability, sex, or having children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone who faced housing discrimination on a Texas property. You must file within one year.
records.how_to_apply: File online with the Housing Discrimination Inquiry Form, or mail or email the paper complaint form.
records.notes: The owner in most cases must own more than three properties (not counting multi-family buildings). You cannot file the same complaint with both TWC and HUD.
records.description_es: Presente una queja si le trataron injustamente al rentar o comprar una casa en Texas por su raza, religión, discapacidad, sexo, por tener hijos u otras razones.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier persona que sufrió discriminación en la vivienda en una propiedad de Texas. Tiene que presentar la queja dentro de un año.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente la queja en internet con el formulario Housing Discrimination Inquiry Form, o mande por correo o email el formulario de queja en papel.
